name: Wyze Bulb Color (US)

radios.note: Wyze lists 802.11 b/g/n on 2.4 GHz plus Bluetooth; setup needs a 2.4 GHz network.

matter.note: Neither Wyze's product page nor its specs page mentions Matter, and we found no CSA listing for this bulb.

apple_home.note: Wyze's pages we saw do not mention Apple Home or HomeKit; not treated as a 'no' because absence is not proof.

google_home.note: Wyze lists Google Assistant and Google Home, linked through the Wyze app's own integration.

alexa.note: Wyze lists Alexa and has a support article on setting it up with the Wyze skill.

smartthings.note: Wyze's pages we saw do not mention SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Wyze's pages we saw do not mention Home Assistant.

hubRequired.note: Wyze's page says the bulb connects directly to Wi-Fi.

localControl.note: No Wyze page we saw states whether the bulb works without the cloud.

colorType.note: 16 million colors plus tunable white from 1800K to 6500K.

lumens.note: Wyze gives a range of 30 to 1100 lumens; 1100 is the maximum.

summary: Wyze Bulb Color (WLPA19C) works with Alexa and Google Home over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, with no hub. It is an A19 bulb with an E26 base: 16 million colors, tunable white from 1800K to 6500K and up to 1100 lumens. Wyze's pages don't mention Matter, Apple Home, SmartThings or Home Assistant, so those stay unconfirmed.
caveats: Wyze does not mention Matter or Apple Home for this bulb, so those are unconfirmed rather than ruled out.
